frontMatter.introduction:
This Standard Operating Procedures (SOP) Manual has been developed to establish a consistent and systematic approach to managing the operations, people, health and safety, environmental, ethical, information security, and supply chain activities of Tagoor Laboratories Pvt. Ltd.

The purpose of this manual is to provide employees, managers, contractors, and other relevant stakeholders with clear guidance on their roles, responsibilities, and operational requirements to ensure compliance with applicable legal, regulatory, customer, and organizational requirements. The procedures contained within this manual support the Company's commitment to operational excellence, employee well-being, environmental stewardship, business integrity, data protection, and sustainable business practices.

All personnel are expected to understand and comply with the requirements outlined in this manual. Department heads and managers are responsible for ensuring effective implementation, communication, and monitoring of the applicable procedures within their areas of responsibility.

This manual shall be reviewed periodically and updated as necessary to reflect changes in business operations, legal requirements, industry best practices, and organizational objectives. The latest approved version shall be maintained as a controlled document and made accessible to relevant personnel.

Failure to comply with the requirements of this manual may result in corrective action in accordance with applicable company policies and procedures.

This document is the property of Tagoor Laboratories Pvt. Ltd. and is intended for internal use only unless otherwise authorized by Management.

frontMatter.reviewMechanism:
This Standard Operating Procedures (SOP) Manual shall be reviewed annually to ensure its continued relevance, effectiveness, and alignment with applicable legal, regulatory, customer, and organizational requirements of Tagoor Laboratories Pvt. Ltd.

The review process shall be coordinated by the HR Manager in consultation with relevant Department Heads and Senior Management. The review shall verify that all procedures remain current, practical, and reflective of actual business operations.

A review may also be initiated under the following circumstances:
Changes in applicable laws, regulations, standards, or compliance requirements.
Introduction of new processes, technologies, equipment, or management systems.
Changes in organizational structure, operational activities, or business requirements.
Findings arising from internal audits, external audits, inspections, incidents, complaints, or corrective actions.
Recommendations from management reviews or continual improvement initiatives.

All revisions, amendments, and updates to this Manual shall be documented and maintained through the Revision Control Record. Updated versions shall be approved before implementation and communicated to relevant personnel.

blocks.text: This procedure defines the end-to-end process followed by Tagoor Laboratories Pvt Ltd for attracting, evaluating, selecting, and onboarding new employees. It ensures that all hiring decisions are transparent, merit-based, consistent, and compliant with applicable labour laws and the company's equal opportunity commitments.

This procedure applies to all permanent, contractual, and temporary positions across all departments and locations of Tagoor Laboratories Pvt Ltd. It is applicable to the Human Resources department, department heads, and all members of interview panels.

responsibilities: Owns the recruitment process, maintains all records, and ensures compliance with this SOP.
Raises manpower requisition, participates in technical interviews, and approves final selection.
Conduct structured assessments and complete evaluation scorecards objectively.
Provides final approval for senior-level appointments.

body.text: The concerned department head completes a Manpower Requisition Form (MRF) specifying the role title, key responsibilities, required qualifications, experience, and budget approval. The MRF is submitted to HR for review and approval before any recruitment activity begins.

HR prepares or updates the Job Description (JD) in consultation with the requesting department. The JD defines reporting structure, key deliverables, technical competencies, and any regulatory or safety certifications required for the role.

Open positions are first communicated internally to give existing employees the opportunity to apply. If no suitable internal candidate is identified, the vacancy is advertised through approved external channels including job portals, recruitment consultants, or campus placement drives as appropriate.

HR reviews all applications received against the eligibility criteria defined in the JD. A shortlist is prepared and shared with the department head for concurrence before candidates are invited for assessment.

All shortlisted candidates undergo a minimum of two structured interview rounds. The HR round assesses behavioural competencies, cultural fitment, and compensation expectations. The Technical/Functional round is conducted by the department head or a subject matter expert and evaluates role-specific knowledge and practical skills. Panel members record their evaluation on standardised Interview Assessment Scorecards, which are retained on file.

Prior to issuing a formal Offer Letter, all selected candidates shall undergo background verification covering previous employment history, educational qualifications, professional references, age verification, and submitted personal documents. HR shall verify the candidate's age eligibility through government-issued identity documents such as Aadhaar Card, Passport, Voter ID, or Driving Licence to confirm that the candidate is 18 years or above at the time of joining. Document verification shall include review of identity proof, PAN Card, educational certificates, experience certificates, relieving letters, and other relevant employment documents, as applicable. Any discrepancy, mismatch, or adverse finding identified during the verification process shall be documented and reviewed by the HR Manager before a final recruitment decision is made.

The HR department issues a formal Offer Letter outlining the designation, compensation, joining date, and terms of employment. Upon acceptance and joining, an Appointment Letter is issued confirming the candidate's employment with Tagoor Laboratories Pvt Ltd.

All new joiners complete a structured induction programme covering company policies, safety procedures, quality standards, departmental orientation, and introduction to key teams. The induction is completed within the first two weeks of joining and is documented on an Onboarding Checklist signed by both HR and the new employee.

blocks.text: Tagoor Laboratories Pvt Ltd is committed to providing equal employment opportunities to all applicants and employees. Recruitment and selection decisions are made solely on the basis of qualifications, competence, and organizational requirements. Discrimination on the basis of gender, caste, religion, nationality, age, disability, or any other protected characteristic is strictly prohibited at every stage of the recruitment process.
